question: Can fixed algorithms identify causal long, short, or abstain entries from raw completed-bar OHLC measurements without regimes, loops, templates, or any prior detector output?

scope.universe_selection: previously assembled twenty-two-stock 2024 convenience cohort; no prior detector outputs are inputs, but symbol selection is inherited, so the experiment is clean with respect to features and models, not independent with respect to universe selection

periods.fold_rule: fit once before each validation month using only eligible anchors whose target exit timestamp is strictly before validation-month start

sources.provider_price_basis: provider OHLC exactly as stored; no independent corporate-action adjustment

universe.training_row_weighting: within each fold and horizon, weights are normalized to mean one and give each represented symbol equal total weight

bar_validation.ohlc_order_required: low <= min(open, close) <= max(open, close) <= high
bar_validation.gap_handling: start a new causal segment whenever adjacent timestamps within a symbol/session differ from exactly five minutes

cohort.candidate_surface: every completed regular-session bar having exact same-session five-minute support through its horizon
cohort.exact_continuity: anchor, entry bar, every intervening bar, and exit bar must occupy one contiguous five-minute symbol/session segment
cohort.entry: open of the bar exactly five minutes after the completed decision bar
cohort.exit: close exactly horizon times five minutes after the decision bar

feature_policy.rolling_scope: current contiguous symbol/session segment only, ending at the completed decision bar
feature_policy.missing_feature_policy: retain missing early-window values and replace them only with the relevant fold-and-horizon training median

formulas.body_and_wicks: fractions of current high-low range, using the frozen zero-range neutral values
formulas.close_return_n: log(close_t/close_t_minus_n) when n exact prior segment bars exist, otherwise missing
formulas.mean_abs_close_return_n: mean absolute one-bar log close return over n complete contiguous returns, otherwise missing
formulas.std_close_return_n: population standard deviation of one-bar log close return over n complete contiguous returns, otherwise missing
formulas.mean_log_range_n: mean log(high/low) over n completed contiguous bars including t, otherwise missing
formulas.session_range_location: (close-running session low)/(running session high-running session low)
formulas.distance_to_rolling_high_n: log(close/rolling n-bar high), with n full contiguous bars required
formulas.distance_from_rolling_low_n: log(close/rolling n-bar low), with n full contiguous bars required
formulas.availability_n: min(number of bars in the current contiguous segment through t divided by n, 1)

algorithms.name: clock_ridge
algorithms.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on training rows only

algorithms.name: full_ridge
algorithms.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on training rows only

prediction_before_outcome_integrity.ledger_contents: anchor key, fold, symbol, session, decision timestamp, clock ordinal, model, horizon, prediction, and fixed actions only

overlap_and_portfolio.greedy_nonoverlap: within each model, horizon, threshold, symbol, and session accept the earliest non-abstaining action and suppress later actions strictly before anchor timestamp plus horizon times five minutes; an action at the prior exit timestamp is eligible
overlap_and_portfolio.within_sleeve_compounding: product of one plus sequential same-day net trade returns minus one
overlap_and_portfolio.daily_portfolio_return: mean of the twenty-two fixed sleeves

costs.interpretation: sensitivity assumptions only; provider OHLC contains no executable spread, slippage, or market impact

inference.paired_sampling: identical dates and blocks for candidate-minus-clock comparisons
inference.multiplicity: the 2.5th-percentile one-sided lower bound is required independently for each of the two candidates, a Bonferroni allocation across full_ridge and full_hgb; all-horizon conjunction is an intersection-union gate

retention_gate_per_candidate.evaluated_only_at: 10 gross-bps action threshold and 5 bps per-side cost
retention_gate_per_candidate.pass_interpretation: retain as a 2024 internal entry hypothesis only and freeze for genuinely unseen post-freeze shadow sessions
retention_gate_per_candidate.failure_interpretation: reject the candidate without changing features, models, thresholds, or gates after opening results

integrity.result_visible_code_correction_policy: any correction after results are visible invalidates v1; a changed design requires v2 and new future data
